description: Implementation of the ReportingCache class managing reporting reports, endpoints, groups, and clients, including adding, removing, evicting, and serializing reports and endpoints, with internal consistency checks.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Client
classes.description: Represents a client with network anonymization key, origin, endpoint count, group names, and last used time.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ReportingReport
classes.description: Represents a reporting report with status, queued time, attempts, and other metadata.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::CachedReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: Represents a cached reporting endpoint group with configuration details.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ReportingEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a reporting endpoint with URL, priority, weight, and statistics.

classes.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Statistics
classes.description: Holds statistics for endpoint delivery attempts, successes, and reports.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::AddReport
methods.description: Adds a new report to the cache, evicting if necessary.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetReports
methods.description: Retrieves active reports excluding doomed and successful ones.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetReportsAsValue
methods.description: Serializes reports into a sorted value list.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetReportsToDeliver
methods.description: Marks and returns reports ready for delivery.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetReportsToDeliverForSource
methods.description: Marks and returns reports for a specific source for delivery.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ClearReportsPending
methods.description: Clears pending reports, updating or removing as appropriate.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::IncrementReportsAttempts
methods.description: Increments attempt count for given reports.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetEndpointStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::IncrementEndpointDeliveries
methods.description: Updates delivery statistics for an endpoint.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::SetExpiredSource
methods.description: Marks a reporting source as expired.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetExpiredSources
methods.description: Returns the set of expired sources.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveSourceAndEndpoints
methods.description: Removes a source and its associated endpoints.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::OnParsedHeader
methods.description: Processes parsed header data to update clients and endpoints.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetAllOrigins
methods.description: Returns all origins with cached clients.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveClient
methods.description: Removes a specific client identified by NIK and origin.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveClientsForOrigin
methods.description: Removes all clients for a specific origin.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveAllClients
methods.description: Removes all clients and associated data.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveEndpointGroup
methods.description: Removes an endpoint group.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::RemoveEndpointsForUrl
methods.description: Removes all endpoints matching a URL.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::AddClientsLoadedFromStore
methods.description: Loads and reconstructs clients, groups, and endpoints from persistent storage.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetCandidateEndpointsForDelivery
methods.description: Returns candidate endpoints for delivery based on group key, considering V1 and V0 logic.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetClientsAsValue
methods.description: Serializes all clients and their groups into a value list.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetEndpointCount
methods.description: Returns total number of endpoints.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::Flush
methods.description: Flushes persisted data if applicable.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific endpoint for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::EndpointGroupExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if an endpoint group exists with specific parameters for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::ClientExistsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a client exists with specific parameters for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetEndpointGroupCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of endpoint groups for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetClientCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of clients for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::GetReportingSourceCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns count of reporting sources for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::SetV1EndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets a V1 endpoint for testing.

methods.name: ReportingCacheImpl::SetEndpointForTesting
methods.description: Sets an endpoint for testing.
